name: Salmon facility exterior and loading
required_outputs: Nine-panel location sheet: hero wide, north/south/east/west coverage, overhead plan with camera markers, ceiling/floor, fixed props/materials, reverse wide
Separate clean full-resolution 16:9 hero and reverse plates, without grid labels
Annotated overhead layout with fixed door/window/prop coordinates and screen axis
Lighting/material palette and day/night variants only when script needs them
Blank screens and signage areas plus separate exact typography overlays
QC record, source references, prompt, model/version, dimensions and file hash
qa_notes: Guard booth is east/right of south gate in the north-up plan, but right of the gate in the south-facing SOUTH and reverse renders, placing it west in those views. This violates the explicit no-mirroring requirement.

Directional labels disagree with rendered views and the specified exterior convention. NORTH shows the north facade viewed from south; SOUTH says looking north but depicts the south gate from inside looking south.
Plan camera B is drawn near the southeast portion of the yard rather than the requested northeast reverse position. Camera icons lack clearly readable look arrows; verify against the reverse plate.
Extra Kitty Punk 2077 wordmark appears in the header despite title/short-label-only instruction.
Retain industrial design and dock assignment; correct booth side and plan/view labels before production blocking.
Generated sheets are review drafts, not production-approved camera or geometry masters.
Architectural design draft; hero dock layout, utility area, gate/booth and floorplan broadly agree. Check all ground-lane arrows against camera-specific continuity before final shot plates.

ownership_note: Production affiliation; not a restriction on which species can appear here.
